sam: Draft hero blurb idea: "Tiny refapps to ship features faster 14; run locally in 3 steps." Will ping design for code-first/product-first variants.

emily: Need 1-line hero blurb for landing page by Mon EOD from owners. I'll create Zoom event + registration.
